spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶1:** [GAP-1] and the [Divine Good operating as] [GAP-2: spiritual justice] surpasses [GAP-3: all else —] the Divine Truth proclaimed through them.

---

**¶3:** This one, whom the heavenly societies called "confirmed in good" [GAP-4] — they confirmed him in the midst of the heavenly societies of wisdom. These innumerable goods and truths distinguished him and set him apart, and he proceeded forth against the assault of falsity from evil. They bestowed this name [GAP-5] upon this purpose [GAP-6] — they who are innumerable, who dwell within the heavenly societies of wisdom and who [GAP-7: REVIEW are beyond] all limit or reckoning.

---

**¶4:** This one, [GAP-8: REVIEW whom the heavenly societies called] "the one perfected in Divine Good," because he is the first being wholly in good who possessed no falsity among all the heavenly societies belonging to wisdom, and the interior perception [GAP-9] by which they recognized him — so that [GAP-10: it was known, becau]se he is the first who acted in perfect accord with the will of Divine Love, who had sent him forth with the five powers of the celestial mind [GAP-11] into the state of spiritual destruction.

---

**¶5:** This one also [GAP-12: REVIEW whom the heavenly societies called] "the sole-proceeding," because he was established [GAP-13] to pour forth [GAP-14] against the dominion of falsity from evil.

---

**¶7:** The sole-proceeding is also distinguished from celestial good and spiritual truth and all the [GAP-15] forms of good and truth throughout creation.

---

**¶8:** The Celestial Human himself stood firm in the [GAP-16: REVIEW midst] of all the states of falsity from evil. He did not love [GAP-17: REVIEW the] states of falsity from evil, nor did he desire conjunction with them. Rather, his interior will and understanding remained wholly directed toward the goods and truths of his heavenly household. Whatever else the power of falsity from evil [GAP-18] wrought through its destructive operations — behold, the Celestial Human labors in spiritual combat so that falsity from evil may be separated from those goods and truths and cast out from among them. And he purifies them and restores them to spiritual freedom, and returns them to the celestial state they possessed from the beginning.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [The deed] and the [righte]o[usness of the Father] is more than [the name and] the voice through them.

This one, whom they called "approved" [he received this name because] they approved him in the midst of the ae[ons of] light. These numerous multitudes set him a[part], and he came forth against the enemy. They gave this name [to him on account of] this matter [ ... ... ] who are numerous, that are in the aeons of light and who [are without] measure or number.

This one, [whom they called] "righteous", because he is the first righteous one who had no sin amongst all of the aeons that belong to the light and the thought [by which] they knew him, so that [it was known becau]se he is the first [wh]o obe[y]ed his Father, who had sent him with five sons [into] perdition.
This one also [whom they called] "only begotten", because he was established [alone to] pour [forth against the] enemy.
[the o]nly begot-ten also from gold and silver and all the [treasures] of the universe.

[The F]irst Man, himself stood firm in the [midst] of all the worlds of Darkness. He did not love [the] worlds of Darkness, nor did he lust for them! Rather, h[is] thought and love for the household of his people is in h[i]m. Anything else that the enemy [did to them] with his violent de[e]ds. Behold, (the First Man) toils and struggles; so that (the enemy) would be separat[e from] them and be cast out from them. And he purifies them and ma[ke]s them f[r]ee, and makes them as they were from the beginning.

fills.explanation: GAP-1 pairs with "righteousness" to form the reality (deed + righteousness) that surpasses the mere designation (name + voice), reflecting the Swedenborgian principle that good in act and good in character exceed truth in proclamation.

The partial word completes "righteousness" and the remaining gap adds "of the Father," expressing the spiritual reading's "Divine Good operating as spiritual justice" in the Kephalaia's natural register where the Father of Greatness is the source.

The spiritual reading's "all else — the Divine Truth proclaimed through them" maps to "the name and the voice," where name and voice are both forms of truth-as-designation that the actual righteousness surpasses.

The parallel naming-explanation formula in ¶4 ("whom they called 'righteous', because...") and ¶5 ("whom they called 'only begotten', because...") strongly constrains ¶3 to follow the same pattern, and "received this name because" is the standard Kephalaia formula for explaining epithets.

The grammar strongly constrains this medium gap: "gave this name" requires an indirect object ("to him") and a causal connection to "this matter" ("on account of"), matching the spiritual reading's "bestowed this name upon this purpose."

The editor's "are without" is confirmed: "without measure or number" is the standard Kephalaia formula for the innumerability of the aeons of light, and the spiritual reading's "are beyond" expresses the same reality.

The editor's "whom they called" is confirmed: this matches the recurring formula in ¶3 and ¶5, where each title of the First Man is introduced with this same phrase, and the spiritual reading confirms the pattern.

The spiritual reading says "the interior perception by which they recognized him," and "the thought by which they knew him" is the natural-register equivalent connecting "thought" to the verb "they knew."
The spiritual reading confirms "it was known, because he is the first who obeyed," and the fill bridges "so that" to the visible "se" forming "because," completing the explanatory clause.

The spiritual reading says "into the state of spiritual destruction," and in Manichaean cosmology the First Man was sent with his five sons into the realm of darkness/perdition to fight, consistent with "into perdition."
The editor's "whom they called" is confirmed: it follows the identical formula used in ¶3 (GAP-4 context) and ¶4 (GAP-8), establishing the consistent naming pattern for each title of the First Man.

The title "only begotten" signifies the sole-proceeding one, and "established alone to pour forth" reflects that he was uniquely set apart for this purpose, corresponding to the spiritual reading's sense of singular establishment.
The spiritual reading says "pour forth against the dominion of falsity from evil," and "pour forth against the enemy" is the natural-register equivalent in the Kephalaia's combat vocabulary.

Following "gold and silver," the spiritual reading's "forms of good and truth throughout creation" maps naturally to "treasures" in the Kephalaia's material-plane register, as treasures correspond to goods and truths stored up in the heavenly sense.

The editor's "midst" is confirmed: "stood firm in the midst of all the worlds of Darkness" is the standard Kephalaia expression for the First Man's position within the realm of darkness, confirmed by the spiritual reading.

The editor's "the" is confirmed: the definite article before "worlds of Darkness" is grammatically required and matches the parallel construction "the worlds of Darkness" that appears immediately before.

The spiritual reading's "wrought through its destructive operations" maps to "did to them" in the natural register, where "them" refers to the household of his people whom the enemy assaults and whom the First Man fights to purify.

assessment: 9 restored, 3 already filled, 5 editorial reviewed (5 confirmed, 0 corrected), 1 unfilled gaps
